states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.authority: Andhra Pradesh State Agricultural Marketing Board (APSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 26 APMCs including Guntur, Vijayawada, and Tirupati.

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.authority: Arunachal Pradesh State Agri Marketing Board / NERAMAC
states.status_note: Regulated physical APMC auction yards are not established under Model APMC Act; agricultural trade occurs via primary rural collection centers (Pasighat, Ziro, Tezu) supported by NERAMAC.

states.name: Assam
states.authority: Assam State Agricultural Marketing Board (ASAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 14 APMCs including Guwahati, Dhing, and Silchar.

states.name: Bihar
states.authority: Department of Agriculture / PACS Cooperative Marketing
states.status_note: APMCs were repealed in 2006; market yards are managed by PACS cooperatives and report to central DMI.

states.name: Chattisgarh
states.authority: Chhattisgarh State Agricultural Marketing Board (CGSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting for Krishi Upaj Mandis including Raipur and Bilaspur.

states.name: Goa
states.authority: Goa State Agricultural Marketing Board (GSAMB)
states.status_note: Operates 5 market yards (Ponda Main, Sanquelim, Curchorem, Margao, Mapusa) trading primarily in Arecanut, Coconut, and Cashewnut via GSAMB & Goa Bagayatdar.

states.name: Gujarat
states.authority: Gujarat State Agricultural Marketing Board (GSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 48 major APMCs including Surat, Rajkot, and Unjha.

states.name: Haryana
states.authority: Haryana State Agricultural Marketing Board (HSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 42 APMCs including Karnal, Ambala, and Hisar.

states.name: Himachal Pradesh
states.authority: Himachal Pradesh State Agricultural Marketing Board (HPSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 28 APMCs including Solan, Shimla, and Kangra.

states.name: Jharkhand
states.authority: Jharkhand State Agricultural Marketing Board (JSAMB) / e-NAM
states.status_note: Active electronic trading across 19 e-NAM integrated APMC yards including Ranchi (Pandra), Jamshedpur, and Dhanbad.

states.name: Karnataka
states.authority: Karnataka State Agri Marketing Board (KSAMB) & ReMS
states.reporting_channel: Unified Market Platform (UMP) / KSAMB Marata Vahini
states.status_note: Integrated electronically on ReMS Unified Market Platform connecting 160+ APMCs across 31 districts.

states.name: Keralam
states.authority: Department of Agricultural Development and Farmers' Welfare
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 52 wholesale markets including Ernakulam, Kozhikode, and Palakkad.

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.authority: Madhya Pradesh State Agricultural Marketing Board (MPSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 54 Krishi Upaj Mandis including Indore, Bhopal, and Ujjain.

states.name: Maharashtra
states.authority: Maharashtra State Agricultural Marketing Board (MSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across APMCs including Pune, Vashi (Navi Mumbai), and Karjat.

states.name: Manipur
states.authority: Manipur State Agricultural Marketing Board
states.status_note: Active daily reporting for Imphal APMC yards.

states.name: Meghalaya
states.authority: Meghalaya State Agricultural Marketing Board
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 5 markets including Shillong and Tura.

states.name: Mizoram
states.authority: Mizoram Agricultural Marketing Board (MAMB) — Mizo Thlai Thar
states.status_note: Collection center and floor price reporting across Aizawl, Kolasib, Champhai, and Lunglei for ginger, turmeric, and chilli.

states.name: Nagaland
states.authority: Nagaland State Agricultural Marketing Board (NSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across Dimapur and Kohima mandis.

states.name: Odisha
states.authority: Odisha State Agricultural Marketing Board (OSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 32 RMC mandis including Baripada, Cuttack, and Sambalpur.

states.name: Punjab
states.authority: Punjab State Agricultural Marketing Board (Punjab Mandi Board)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 46 APMCs including Ludhiana, Amritsar, and Jalandhar.

states.name: Rajasthan
states.authority: Rajasthan State Agricultural Marketing Board (RSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 29 Krishi Upaj Mandis including Jaipur, Jodhpur, and Kota.

states.name: Sikkim
states.authority: SIMFED & Sikkim State Organic Certification Agency (SSOCA)
states.status_note: India's first 100% certified organic state; conventional APMC mandis do not operate. Agricultural trade is organized through SIMFED procurement hubs (Gangtok, Rangpo, Nayabazar) for certified organic cash crops.

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.authority: Tamil Nadu State Agricultural Marketing Board (TNSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 184 market committees including Koyambedu, Madurai, and Coimbatore.

states.name: Telangana
states.authority: Telangana State Agricultural Marketing Department
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 34 APMCs including Bowenpally, Warangal, and Nizamabad.

states.name: Tripura
states.authority: Tripura State Agricultural Marketing Board
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 8 mandis including Agartala APMC.

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.authority: UP State Agricultural Marketing Board (UP Mandi Parishad)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 22 mandis including Shadabad, Gulavati, and Agra.

states.name: Uttarakhand
states.authority: Uttarakhand State Agricultural Marketing Board (UKAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 19 mandis including Dehradun, Haridwar, and Haldwani.

states.name: West Bengal
states.authority: West Bengal State Agricultural Marketing Board (WBSAMB)
states.status_note: Active daily reporting across 28 regulated market committees including Silguri, Asansol, and Burdwan.

union_territories.name: Andaman and Nicobar
union_territories.status_note: Active daily reporting for Port Blair APMC.

union_territories.name: Chandigarh
union_territories.authority: State Agricultural Marketing Board, UT Chandigarh
union_territories.status_note: Active daily reporting for Sector 26 Fruit & Vegetable Market.

union_territories.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
union_territories.status_note: Regulated producing APMC mandis are not established in D&NH and D&D. Wholesale prices are monitored by the Department of Consumer Affairs PMD at Silvassa; commercial supplies arrive via neighbouring APMC Vapi (Gujarat).

union_territories.name: Delhi
union_territories.authority: Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board (DAMB) / APMC Azadpur
union_territories.reporting_channel: APMC Azadpur Daily Bazar Rates & e-NAM Delhi
union_territories.status_note: Active daily wholesale rates published by APMC Azadpur (Asia's largest terminal fruit & vegetable market) across 10 major commodities.

union_territories.name: Jammu and Kashmir
union_territories.status_note: Active daily reporting across 8 mandis including Narwal (Jammu) and Parimpora (Srinagar).

union_territories.name: Ladakh
union_territories.authority: Directorate of Agriculture, UT Ladakh / PMD Leh & Kargil
union_territories.reporting_channel: Local Cooperative Auctions & PMD Price Monitoring
union_territories.status_note: No regulated physical APMC mandis exist in Ladakh due to terrain and climate. Local apricot (Halman / Raktsey Karpo) trade is handled via cooperative societies, and essential food wholesale prices are monitored by PMD in Leh and Kargil.

union_territories.name: Lakshadweep
union_territories.authority: Department of Agriculture / LDCL / PMD Kavaratti
union_territories.reporting_channel: Government Procurement (LDCL Copra MSP) & PMD Kavaratti
union_territories.status_note: Island territory with no regulated APMC mandi yards. Commercial agriculture centers on Copra (procured under MSP by LDCL); food supplies are transported via mainland Kochi (Ernakulam APMC, Kerala). Prices are monitored by PMD in Kavaratti.

union_territories.name: Pondicherry
union_territories.status_note: Active daily reporting for Puducherry APMC.
